Create a new policy package in the specified ADOM.

Key fields:
- name: package name (FortiSASE)
- type: 'pkg' for a regular package
- ngfw-mode: 0 = profile-based
- central-nat: 0 = disabled
- policy-offload-level: 0 = default

Expected response: result[0].status.code == 0

Assign a device/VDOM as an installation target (scope member) for the policy package.

Note: This call REPLACES the scope member list. To ADD without removing existing members,
first GET the current scope members and include them all in the data array.

Expected response: result[0].status.code == 0

        set type physical

        set ip 10.$(lan_id).101.1 255.255.255.0

        set type physical
    next

        set type tunnel
        set interface "port1"
    next
end
config system dhcp server
    edit 10
        set dns-service local
        set default-gateway 10.$(lan_id).1.1
        set netmask 255.255.255.0
        set interface "port5"
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set start-ip 10.$(lan_id).1.101
                set end-ip 10.$(lan_id).1.105
            next
        end
    next
    edit 3
        set dns-service local
        set default-gateway 10.$(lan_id).101.1

        end
    next
end
config system dns-database
    edit "unisase"
        set domain "unisase.lab"
        set authoritative disable
        set forwarder "10.1.0.7" 
    next
end
config system dns-server
    edit "port6"
    next
    edit "port5"
    next
end"
